title: ETag, 304, public cache lifetimes and If-Match for the native backend
why: Repeat reads cost a 304 instead of a full body, public catalogs can be served by a CDN with stale-while-revalidate, and editors cannot silently overwrite each other.

adopt.snippet:
<meta server>
export default { products: { maxAge: '1m', staleWhileRevalidate: '10m' } }
